en: A colorized or tinted vintage photograph of a coastal fortress with curved ramparts and a central gateway leading to the sea. The fortress is built from stone with regularly spaced embrasures and a prominent round tower on the right. There are a couple of white sailboats in the water and an old cannon and anchor displayed near the wall. There are benches and flowerbeds in the foreground.
